AboutMe.Title: About me
AboutMe.Paragraphs: In years of software development, I've taken on roles as a Fullstack developer using Angular and a Golang/Python/Java.
I also have experience in machine learning, developing predictive models and integrating analytics into applications to support data-driven decision-making.
Additionally, I have worked on REST APIs development, CI/CD, and Automation of unit, contract and component tests to enhance efficiency and maintainability.
